notes.title: Update Information: January 22, 2020
notes.content:
This message will explain the free updates coming to DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT and DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT Free Edition on Thursday January, 22, 2020.

Free Update

■Character Rank Additions and Adjustments
■Ultima Rank Addition
Ultima Class will be added as a rank higher than Crystal Class 

・Ultima Class Mode
This is an addition to Online battles only
This has not been added to Offline Battles.

■Ultima Battles
With the addition of Ultima Class, Ultima Battles will also be implemented. 

We hope you continue to enjoy DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT.

notes.title: Check Out the Latest DLC for DISSIDIA® FINAL FANTASY® NT!
notes.content:
The new DLC allows Warrior of Light and Y'shtola to be equipped with:
* Warrior of Light
- Knight in Shining Armor I (Appearance)
- Knight in Shining Armor II (Appearance)
- Knight in Shining Armor III (Appearance)
- Barbarian's Sword/Aegis (Weapon)
- Additional Chat Messages

* Y'shtola
- Scion Sorceress's Robe I (Appearance)
- Scion Sorceress's Robe II (Appearance)
- Scion Sorceress's Robe III (Appearance)
- Nightseeker (Weapon)
- Additional Chat Messages

* You must first purchase the game DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT or download DISSIDA FINAL FANTASY NT Free Edition before you can use this content.

* If you are playing DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT Free Edition, you must first purchase the Warrior of Light Starter Pack and Y'shtola Starter Pack before you can use this content.

notes.title: Update Information: April 25, 2019
notes.content:
Here you can find information about the free update on April 25, 2019.
Free Update (Steam Only)

[b]System Changes[/b]
In order to reduce latency during ranked matches, players will no longer be matched against each other if they are geographically far apart.
We hope you continue to enjoy DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY NT.
